title: County Attorney Evaluation of Police Software

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

In an October 22, 2026, memo, the City of North Liberty indicates the Johnson County Attorney's Office "has reviewed and approved the Police Department's use of" Axon Draft One software.

I am requesting the records related to that review and the county attorney's approval, including records of the applicable review procedures and standards, the review request from North Liberty, documentation submitted for review, and the county attorney's report.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

HCvP

communications.subject: Iowa Open Records Law Request: Barnacle Strategic Communication Approval
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Iowa Open Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

All applications, approvals, and related records concerning the use of the University name by ITSA Solutions LLC (dba Barnacle Parking), and any similar record showing compliance with, or exemption from, University Police Chapter 33.

To help locate the records; at least some responsive records should exist for the website
https://www.barnacleparking.com/blog/a-barnacle-success-story-the-university-of-iowa/

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

HCvP
